description: This Java class 'ImmutableJsonArrayBuilder' is a builder pattern implementation for constructing immutable JSON array objects within the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It provides methods to add various data types and build an ImmutableJsonArray.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArrayBuilder
classes.description: A final class implementing JsonArrayBuilder, providing methods to construct immutable JSON arrays through a fluent API.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of ImmutableJsonArrayBuilder.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Overloaded methods to add different data types (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue) and their respective collections or varargs to the builder.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Methods to set a value at a specific index in the array for various data types.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the value at the specified index, if present.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an element at a specified index or a specific value from the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an ImmutableJsonArray from the accumulated values.
